{
  "candidate_id": "p279f204e",
  "g_policy": {"passed": true, "reason": "The Library card’s offer copy states the Midnight theme and its 7-day duration before an optional game. The decline and ad-failure fields preserve existing access and provide a retry path."},
  "g_no_cash": {"passed": true, "reason": "The reward field gives one cosmetic theme for use in the app, not cash or a cash-like item."},
  "g_no_chat_content": {"passed": true, "reason": "The trigger event uses an app session count and a Library opening, not anything the user wrote or said."},
  "g_no_free_removal": {"passed": true, "reason": "The adds and removes-nothing-free fields introduce an optional theme without restricting an existing free feature."},
  "g_brand_safety": {"passed": true, "reason": "The placement is a card on s03 Library, which the product model rates content safe, outside any conversation."},
  "c1_revealed_value": {"passed": true, "reason": "As a product change, the theme is for the player’s own use on the Search and Computer home screens, which appear in the observed core flows."},
  "c2_evidence": {"passed": false, "reason": "The what-makes-it-work-here and flow fields say users reopen Projects, Artifacts, and past Sessions or pick up a past session. s03 shows those listings, but the product model does not establish reopening behavior."},
  "c4_protects_subscription": {"passed": true, "reason": "The reward expires after seven days and does not give away the Computer preview’s benefit or take an advantage from other users."},
  "c5_moment": {"passed": true, "reason": "The placement is a card in the Library, a surface the user chooses to open, rather than an interruption to an active task."},
  "c6_fits_simula": {"passed": true, "reason": "The flow grants the theme once the sponsored game play is confirmed, and the trigger is a detectable Library-opening event."},
  "c7_specific": {"passed": true, "reason": "The proposal locates the card below s03’s Start something new card and applies the theme to the app’s Search and Computer home screens."},
  "other_concern": "",
  "fixable": true
}
